title: The Battery Designed for Second Life
short_teaser: Electric-vehicle batteries may retain useful capacity after they are no longer ideal for driving.
story: Electric-vehicle batteries may retain useful capacity after they are no longer ideal for driving. Repurposing them for stationary storage extends their value. Innovation can come from redesigning the end of a product’s life. Innovation is usually a chain of observations, tests, failures, adjustments, and connections that gradually become useful. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
